title: braya verticillata
intro: Braya verticillata, commonly known as the mountain avens or alpine avens, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Braya verticillata include its potential to treat various ailments, such as gastrointestinal issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in Braya verticillata include glucosinolates, which are sulfur-containing compounds that have been shown to have anti-cancer properties.
